answer_verbatim:
Do you mean a UV (bed) tanning salon or a spray/airbrush (sunless) salon? I can give a short list of top local salons if you want — or, if you prefer, tips to pick the best one yourself.

What I can do now:
- If you want, I’ll look up current top-rated salons in Pleasanton and give names, addresses, hours and recent review summaries. (Tell me you want me to search and a ZIP or part of town if you have a preference.)
- Or I can give quick guidance on how to choose the best salon and what to check before booking.

Quick tips for choosing the best tanning salon
- Decide UV bed vs spray tan. Spray/airbrush is safest for no-UV color.
- Read recent Google and Yelp reviews and look at customer photos.
- Check certifications/safety practices (trained techs, clean equipment, eye/skin protection, patch tests for spray).
- Ask about machines/solutions: newer beds with timers and maintenance, or organic/vegan spray solutions if you care.
- Visit first: cleanliness, friendly staff, ventilation, and ask for a portfolio of spray results.
- Compare prices, packages and membership cancelation policies.

Tell me which option you want (UV or spray), and whether you want me to look up current top salons in Pleasanton.
